newsitem.title: USA: APA Optics Q1 margins fall.
newsitem.headline: APA Optics Q1 margins fall.

text.p: APA Optics Inc said Wednesday gross profit margin decreased to 19 percent for the first three months of fiscal 1998 from 34 percent for the first three quarters of fiscal 1997.
The decrease was due to hiring staff and purchasing equipment for the company's Aberdeen fabrication facility.
The company hopes to be in production at that facility by September, chief executive officer Anil Jain said in a news release.
Earlier Wednesday, APA reported a net loss of $28,935, nil per share, for the first quarter ended June 30, compared with a loss of $63,517, or $0.01 a share, a year ago.
The company manufactures and markets advanced products for the fiber optic communications, optoclectronics and laser industries.
APA shares were unchanged at 5-1/2 Wednesday.
